nodes.label: Workspace Canvas Shell (Shell.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Per-page navigation layouts duplicate layout code and cause layout shift during transitions. A global parent shell in src/app/shell/ owns sidebar, top bar, background glows, responsive behavior and command palettes; routes mount as nested children in its <main>. Rejected putting the layout in TanStack Router's __root.tsx because full-screen boot animations and error boundaries must bypass the sidebar. Trade-off: pages must fit the shell's grid. Status: Accepted.
